# I'm Claude, an AI assistant made by Anthropic

I don't have a public API in the traditional sense. However, here are your options for using me:

## **Official Access**
- **Claude.ai** - Free web interface (some features require paid plan)
- **Claude API** - Anthropic offers an API for developers
  - Available at [console.anthropic.com](https://console.anthropic.com)
  - Pay-as-you-go pricing
  - Full documentation available

## **Third-party Integrations**
Some platforms integrate Claude:
- Slack, Gmail, and other tools (via various apps)
- Some AI platforms and services

## **What I Am**
- I'm a large language model (LLM) trained by Anthropic
- I can help with: writing, analysis, coding, math, creative tasks, and more
- I work through this chat interface

**Are you looking to:**
- Use Claude for personal tasks? → Visit [claude.ai](https://claude.ai)
- Integrate Claude into your app? → Check the [API documentation](https://docs.anthropic.com)
- Use Claude through another platform? → Let me know which one

What's your use case?
